name: Julia Lason
bio: Mrs. Julia Lason was seriously ill in April 1885 but expected to recover. In June 1885 Patrick O'Hara of the Medora Coal Co. bought her house in Little Missouri to move to Medora.

moments.label: Sold her Little Missouri house to Patrick O'Hara

mentions: Mrs. Lason has been very sick but the chances now are that she will recover.
Mr. Patrick O'Hara of the Medora coal Co., has bought Mrs. Julia Lason's house in Little Missouri, and will move it to Medora in a few weeks.
Pat O'Hara has sold his house in Little Missouri, formerly occupied by Mrs. Lason. The present owner intends furnishing and renting it.
